name: Sparrow Open-Source Webhook Delivery
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook delivery platform with asynchronous fan-out, retries, HMAC signing, delivery history, health tracking and payload transforms; no vendor-imposed free software quota.
watch_out: No free managed webhook hosting or infrastructure is included. Operate your own Go server and PostgreSQL, secure public endpoints, monitor delivery and pay for compute, networking, backups and storage. At-least-once delivery can repeat events; consumers need idempotency. Preserve MIT license notices.
